meta: Motorbike mechanics use AI to explain faults and quotes clearly, so customers don't suspect they're being upsold.

muc.title: Customers don't understand
muc.text: Customers often suspect mechanics of inventing problems, just because they hear part names without understanding what's broken.

muc.title: Plain words for customers
muc.text: Type the bike's condition into a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask it to explain in plain words for the customer.

muc.title: Itemize every cost
muc.text: Ask AI to split the quote clearly: parts, labor, what must be done now and what can wait.

muc.title: The mechanic decides, AI writes
muc.text: AI only helps write it clearly. The diagnosis and price are still decided by the mechanic checking the bike.

muc.title: A sample quote message
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to draft a sample quote message for a brake pad replacement.
